{{dablink|For other uses of the word "blade," see [[Blade]].}}
'''Master of the Blades''' is the title given to the male leader of the ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' as a counterpart to the [[Mistress of the Ships]], though he does not hold as much rule as she. It is common for the Master of the Blades to be married to the Mistress of the Ships, though it is not required of the position. The Master of the Blades is responsible for the trade and security of the the ''Atha'an Miere''.
